info.title: First Domino API
info.summary: Finds the step where a failed AI agent run became doomed, and proves it.

get.description: Answers without auth while the process serves requests.
Returns the project the token or API key belongs to.

post.summary: Set or clear the Slack webhook
post.description: Sets the Slack incoming webhook that hears about each new cause, or clears it.
Creates a project API key. The full key is in `secret` and is never shown again.
Lists the project's API keys, newest first, revoked ones included.
Revokes an API key at once. Revoking a revoked key returns it unchanged.

Starts recording a run.

With `replay_job_id`, the run is a replay linked to the job's original run. The job must
be leased (`404` when the project has no such job, `409` when it is not leased).

Finishes a running run (`409` when already finished).

A recorded run that finishes `failed` is diagnosed automatically.

get.description: Returns one run of the caller's project.

post.description: Lists runs, newest first. Recorded runs only unless `sources` says otherwise.
Counts the runs that match the same filters as `listRuns`.

Records one step of a running run (`409` when the run is finished).

Idempotent on (`run_id`, `index`): a repeat returns the stored step and changes nothing,
even after the run finished.

post.summary: List the steps of a run
post.description: Lists the steps of a run in index order.

get.summary: Get the save point after a step
get.description: Returns the full message list saved after a step.

post.description:
Starts diagnosing a failed recorded run.

Answers `409` when the run is not a failed recorded run or a diagnosis of it is running.

get.description: Returns one diagnosis. Poll it while `status` is not `done` or `failed`.

post.description: Lists diagnoses, newest first. The runs of a cause come from `cause_ids`.
Counts the diagnoses that match the same filters as `listDiagnoses`.

post.summary: List the checks of a diagnosis
post.description: Lists the checks of a diagnosis in `index` order.
Lists root causes, most runs first.

get.description: Returns one root cause. Its runs come from `listDiagnoses` with `cause_ids`.

post.description: Counts the causes that match the same filters as `listCauses`.

get.description: Returns the newest benchmark scores, or null when none has run.

post.description:
Waits up to `wait_seconds` for a queued job for one of `agent_names` and leases it.

Answers with a null job when none arrived in time; lease again.

Reports how a replay ended.

Idempotent by `replay_job_id`: the first result for a leased job counts, and any later
one (a repeat, or a late result from an earlier lease) changes nothing.

DiagnosisErrorCode.title: DiagnosisErrorCode
DiagnosisErrorCode.description:
Why a diagnosis ended `failed`.

`replay_unavailable`: every replay of a check errored or timed out (is a worker running?).
`check_budget_exceeded`: the search needed more checks than allowed.
`llm_not_configured`: the engine has no model key or model id.
`llm_call_failed`: a model call failed before returning anything.
`interrupted`: the API process running it stopped heartbeating (for example, it restarted).
`internal_error`: anything else; see the API logs.

VerdictKind.title: VerdictKind
VerdictKind.description:
What a finished diagnosis concluded.

`step_verified`: one step was found and fixing it flipped the outcome.
`step_unverified`: one step was found but fixing it did not flip the outcome often enough.
`multiple_causes`: no single step fix flipped the outcome.
`task_or_tool_issue`: even a fresh run fails, so no agent step is to blame.
